Dr Rhodes on Apr 21st and he was prompt with my appointment and very, very understanding of all my needs.
I'd booked a double appointment as it's a complex issue and I'd written some notes as I'm not very good at speaking face to face when I'm nervous and he had the courtesy to read my notes and answer all of my questions completely honestly with no brushing issues under the carpet.
I ended up needing to be admitted to hospital during my appointment due to an immediate and very serious health issue and although he knew I was petrified of hospital, he was so lovely and reassuring and explained why it was vital I went immediately and he had me on the hospital's triage list before I even left the surgery and he made sure I could get there safely (luckily I had my Dad with me as I've been unwell for a long time and currently don't feel safe enough to drive).
From now on, I will always see Dr Rhodes - he is an absolute credit to the surgery. He's very courteous, straightforward and honest and he actually LISTENS to his patients and if he can't honestly answer a particular question, he'll tell you so but will try and get you answers.
Without Dr Rhodes' quick-thinking and help, I could well have had serious and maybe even fatal consequences.
I've dealt with Dr Rhodes four times now and each and every time, he has been so helpful and has given me the best care and has actually managed to get me referred for tests I've needed and he has never made me feel bad about myself.

As for the receptionists, I must have been lucky as I've mostly found them to be absolutely lovely both over the phone and in person. It's only very rarely that one has been a bit short-tempered but they must go through a lot each day and I've heard them being abused by people because appointments are running late.

The healthcare assistant, Alicia is so lovely and so is Kevin and there's another lady who also takes my blood (I think she's called Sarah) and they're all lovely too.

I do agree about that waiting room though - it's very dull and depressing with all of the exposed brickwork and no windows and the stained skylights - it needs brightening up and the noticeboards need bringing up to
